name: MicroPort MedBot
description: Shanghai MicroPort MedBot (Group) Co., Ltd. is a surgical robotics company founded in 2015 in Shanghai, China, as a subsidiary of MicroPort Scientific Corporation. Its commercial portfolio includes the [Toumai](/robot/medbot_toumai) multiport laparoscopic surgical robot and the [Skywalker](/robot/medbot_skywalker) orthopedic joint replacement system, alongside joint ventures with [Robocath](/company/robocath) and [Biobot Surgical](/company/biobot_surgical).
